passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Ophrys × chobautii G.Keller ex B.Tyteca & D.Tyteca.
The native range of this hybrid is SW. Europe. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is O. lutea × O. speculum.
